ir.name: gap_pairs_safe_int_002
ir.intuition: Construct pairwise preferences by declaring a strict win whenever an item's objective is at least gap_threshold lower than another in the same batch instance; optionally cap to max_pairs_per_instance per instance to control compute while keeping deterministic earliest-order pairs.
ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']

    # Avoid Python builtins like float/int: keep everything tensor-native.
    gap_val = extra.get('gap_threshold', objective.new_zeros(()) )
    if not torch.is_tensor(gap_val):
        gap_val = objective.new_tensor(gap_val)

    max_pairs = extra.get('max_pairs_per_instance', 4096)

    n_batch = objective.shape[0]

    # Prefer lower objective; winner w beats loser l if obj[w] + gap < obj[l]
    mask = (objective[:, :, None] + gap_val) < objective[:, None, :]
    b_all, w_all, l_all = mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)

    # Ensure int64 1D indices
    b_all = b_all.to(dtype=torch.long)
    w_all = w_all.to(dtype=torch.long)
    l_all = l_all.to(dtype=torch.long)

    if b_all.numel() == 0:
        return PrefBatch(
            mode='pairwise',
            pair_idx=(b_all, w_all, l_all),
            weight=None,
            meta={'builder': 'gap_pairs_safe_int', 'gap_threshold': gap_val, 'max_pairs_per_instance': max_pairs},
        )

    if (max_pairs is None) or (max_pairs <= 0):
        return PrefBatch(
            mode='pairwise',
            pair_idx=(b_all, w_all, l_all),
            weight=None,
            meta={'builder': 'gap_pairs_safe_int', 'gap_threshold': gap_val, 'max_pairs_per_instance': max_pairs},
        )

    # Cap pairs per instance deterministically by scanning in existing order.
    counts = objective.new_zeros((n_batch,), dtype=torch.long)
    keep = objective.new_zeros((b_all.shape[0],), dtype=torch.bool)

    i = 0
    total = b_all.shape[0]
    while i < total:
        b = b_all[i].item()
        if counts[b].item() < max_pairs:
            keep[i] = True
            counts[b] = counts[b] + 1
        i = i + 1

    b_idx = b_all[keep]
    w_idx = w_all[keep]
    l_idx = l_all[keep]

    return PrefBatch(
        mode='pairwise',
        pair_idx=(b_idx, w_idx, l_idx),
        weight=None,
        meta={'builder': 'gap_pairs_safe_int', 'gap_threshold': gap_val, 'max_pairs_per_instance': max_pairs},
    )

ir.name: builder_anchor_only_v2
ir.intuition: Construct exactly one pairwise preference per instance by anchoring the lowest-objective candidate as winner over the highest-objective candidate as loser, dropping any degenerate/tied cases so every emitted pair represents a strict improvement.
ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    B, N = objective.shape
    device = objective.device

    # Rank by objective (lower is better)
    order = torch.argsort(objective, dim=1, stable=True)
    best = order[:, 0]
    worst = order[:, -1]

    b_idx = torch.arange(B, device=device, dtype=torch.int64)
    winner_idx = best.to(dtype=torch.int64)
    loser_idx = worst.to(dtype=torch.int64)

    # Remove degenerate pairs
    valid = winner_idx != loser_idx
    b_idx = b_idx[valid]
    winner_idx = winner_idx[valid]
    loser_idx = loser_idx[valid]

    # Enforce strict improvement (winner objective < loser objective)
    if b_idx.numel() > 0:
        ow = objective[b_idx, winner_idx]
        ol = objective[b_idx, loser_idx]
        good = ow < ol
        b_idx = b_idx[good]
        winner_idx = winner_idx[good]
        loser_idx = loser_idx[good]

    # Ensure 1D int64
    b_idx = b_idx.reshape(-1).to(dtype=torch.int64)
    winner_idx = winner_idx.reshape(-1).to(dtype=torch.int64)
    loser_idx = loser_idx.reshape(-1).to(dtype=torch.int64)

    return PrefBatch(
        mode='pairwise',
        pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx),
        weight=None,
        meta={'builder': 'anchor_only_v2'}
    )
